notes: Run `conda run -n lammps_agent python backend/benchmarks/train_llm_route_mlp.py` to retrain the local MLP model.
Guarded mode applies only recommendations above confidence_threshold.
Capability floors still prevent scientific code, repair, review, and vision tasks from being downgraded unsafely.
Copy this file to backend/configs/llm_routing.json to enable local overrides.
Do not place real API keys in this JSON. Keep keys in backend/.env, backend/configs/.env, process env, or your secret manager.
The fast tier uses the official DeepSeek `deepseek-v4-flash` id; balanced/strong/vision inherit the central LLM config unless explicitly added here.
When this file is absent, all tiers safely inherit backend/configs/llm_config.json and the current PHASE_DIAGRAM_LLM_* settings.
